description: What changed on a web page since you last looked: pass url; the first call returns a snapshot token, call again with since=<token> to get the text lines that appeared and disappeared. $0.005 per call over x402.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the same base64 payload you would put in the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header). Pass it here and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

since.description: the token from your previous call on this page (16 hex characters); leave out on the first call

url.description: the public web page to watch

name: page_watch
title: Page watch
